title: You can have a question without having a position
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Narrow the question — Identify the actual claim or decision being discussed.; Map what is known — Separate observations, inferences, and important gaps.; Decide if action is due — Distinguish a needed choice from pressure for a public opinion.; State a provisional view — Attach the judgment to its assumptions and review trigger..
